subject: Status: Basalt feature audit + licensing risk
body:
Status on the audit.

Good news: the standardized schema holds up — id/image/segmentation features are consistent everywhere, background is always class 0 with dataset-specific classes above it, and the segmentation_mseg_universal channel gives us the single shared label space we promised.

Gaps to know about: person_keypoints exists only where the source provides it (COCO being the main one), and box_labels one-hot dimensions differ per dataset, so downstream code needs the per-dataset class count from the feature spec — Rosa is adding that to loader metadata.

Risk: licensing. Beyond WildDash (already excluded), two more sources carry research-only clauses that may block Corpus redistribution. Kofi's review is the gate and his SLA is 2-3 weeks, which puts an answer mid-April — tight against the integration prototype. Suggest Umar builds against the unambiguous sets first.

Csilla
